cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Let Me Lean
cards.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Could you cancel our anniversary table? The restaurant number's on the fridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Please let the call be the first thing you take off me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call. They might ask whether you want another date.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say no for me. Then stay while I put the anniversary glasses away. You can tell me about your day.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 asks B to take a burden without naming it, but professional correction has no object beyond a stock phrase.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 asks what happened; A3 deliberately defers disclosure; B4's rescheduling concern earns A5's answer and company request.

relationship.evidence: B4 accepts the task and anticipates a real question from the restaurant.

heightening.evidence: A5 develops B4's practical help into staying through another emotionally loaded task.
